newsitem.title: USA: AGCO Corp to buy Deutz Argentina.
newsitem.headline: AGCO Corp to buy Deutz Argentina.

text.p: AGCO Corporation on Monday said it has agreed to acquire the operations of Deutz Argentina SA, a supplier of agricultural equipment, engines and trucks to Argentina and other markets of Latin America.

Financial details were not disclosed. AGCO said Deutz Argentina had average annual sales volume of $130 million over the last three years. The acquisition is expected to be completed before the end of 1996.
AGCO's purchase will include the aquisition of Deutz Argentina's three manufacturing and assembly facilities.

In a statement, Robert J. Ratliff, Chairman and chief executive of AGCO Corp, said "Deutz Argentina's production facilities provide the opportunity for AGCO to produce and assemble products at a competitive price for local markets and increased export potential through the AGCO distribution network."
AGCO, based in Duluth, Ga., manufactures and distributes agricultural equipment.
